I answered Pree in a thread on her message in #central-random: the ticket is #8841.

Tobias raised it for support in #central-random yesterday (13 Oct, 09:27). He said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk.

He didn't name Marrow Fieldworks in that message. I matched it up this way:
- Hollis asked him about "Tobias's dealer account" just before.
- The 5 Jan handoff note says Marrow Fieldworks, Pree's dealer account at the time, was changing hands that Monday.

I also warned her not to mix it up with #88412. That number looks similar but is the old Tansleigh Packaging ticket about the Door 6 scanner. I haven't seen any update on #8841 since Tobias raised it, so I suggested she check with him on where it stands before the call.
